escena: SCENE (cinematic, ensemble movie poster still, the hero walk of the reinforcements arriving, a vast dark hangar at night, the native layout of a square feed ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 44% of the frame is the deep, evenly dark, navy-black matte ceiling of the hangar with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no glow, no bokeh, no lamps and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 46% and 84% of the frame height. The LOWEST 20% of the frame is a tall near-black matte stage riser right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, its top edge at about 80% of the frame height, completely out of focus, non-reflective and untouched by the door light: their waists and legs are hidden behind it and no floor, no shadow and no reflection is visible below its top edge. THE MOMENT: far behind them, a huge hangar door stands wide open onto a blazing warm orange (#FF6500) light that floods the haze, its top edge at about 48% of the frame height. Out of that light, a creative squad of EXACTLY FOUR Latin American people in their late twenties to early forties, two women and two men with varied hair, all wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, walk toward the camera mid-stride in ONE line shoulder to shoulder, framed from the waist up, the TOP of all four heads at about 54% of the frame height and all four heads in the same band between 54% and 64%, the riser cutting them at the waist; they all look straight into the lens with calm, determined expressions. THE SPARKS, copied EXACTLY from their two references, each smaller than a head, above the waist: the Content Spark flies just beside the shoulder of the woman second from the left, sharp; the Reports Spark flies beside the shoulder of the man on the right, sharp. Behind the squad, in the orange haze of the door, EXACTLY THREE more Sparks (FIVE in total, never more), the same figures as the two references, small and clearly OUT OF FOCUS. LIGHT: the open door is the only key light: a strong warm orange backlight that rims their hair, shoulders and hoodies ; their faces are lit only by a soft, low cool azure (#0375DB) bounce from the front, faces readable but dark; NO other fill. Thin haze catches the door's light, only below 46%. Nobody looks at anybody else. Camera low at chest height about five meters in front of them, 85mm, realistic adult proportions, nothing foreshortened. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Real faces with natural skin, irregular pores, no retouching. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any other brand.
